title: Reading the next tape cell
statement: For Boolean lists $l$ and $r$ and a Boolean $b$, the tape storing the concatenated word $l$ followed by $b$ and then $r$ contains $b$ at the integer position equal to the length of $l$.
replaced:
For bit strings $l, r$ and a bit $b$, the buffer tape of the concatenation
$l \cdot b \cdot r$ (holding the string in cells $0, 1, \dots$ with blanks
elsewhere) reads exactly $b$ at position $|l|$.
